text:
I don't have access to the sqlpipe source code or network access to retrieve it, so I can't give you the exact message text without risking fabricating it — which would be worse than not answering.

To find it yourself:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sqlpipe/sqlpipe
grep -r "AccessDenied\|PutObject\|s3.*error\|upload.*fail" sqlpipe/ --include="*.go" -n
```

Or reproduce it directly by running sqlpipe against an S3 bucket with a restricted IAM policy and capturing stderr.
